pages.text: Before entering the dimension, I tried to gather as much information as possible. It wasnt that easy, because most of the garbage gets into our dimension, but I managed to get some valuable things. A square metal box stood out from all of them, which glowed, there was something written on it, but the inscription caught my eye $(#ff0000)EXIT$().
When I tried to interact with the box, it went out and the smell of burning hung in the air, perhaps once in the dimension I would be able to get the same or $(#ff0000)create something similar...$()
